verdict: $592 spent, zero leads — the paid funnel is broken and being fixed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Ads campaigns spent $591.94 across 124 clicks and returned zero leads — this is a funnel or conversion-tracking failure, not a volume problem. Local intent is clearly present: your Google Business Profile logged 38 actions this period, 37 of which were direction requests, but none of that interest is being captured by the paid search funnel. Conversion tracking is being repaired and a full end-to-end stack test is scheduled for August 31, at which point the connection between ad clicks and recorded leads will be verified and corrected. New paid landing pages are also going live this week, which should give clicks a proper destination to convert on. Once tracking is confirmed clean, you should expect leads to begin registering; until then, spend is being watched closely to avoid amplifying waste.
